lines.text: Two prostitutes came before the king, and one said the other woman had a baby on the third day after her.
One woman said the other woman's son died because she rolled over on him, and she swapped the babies while she slept.
The two women argued before the king, and he called for a spear.
The king ordered the living child cut in two, but he gave the baby to the woman who begged him to spare it.
When all Israel heard the judgment, they stood in awe of the king because they saw the wrath of God in him.
